Looking at the table, the character "担 / 擔" (jyutping: daam3) has a metric value of "60.478982 kg". I need to check if any other character also has a metric value measured in kg.

Checking each row:
- lei4 (厘): metric value is "37.79931 mg" (milligrams, not kg)
- fan1 (分): metric value is "377.9936375 mg" (milligrams, not kg)
- cin4 (錢): metric value is "3.779936375 g" (grams, not kg)
- loeng2 (兩): metric value is "37.79936375 g" (grams, not kg)
- gan1 (斤): metric value is "604.78982 g" (grams, not kg)
- daam3 (担 / 擔): metric value is "60.478982 kg" (kilograms)

Only "担 / 擔" has "kg" in its metric value column. All others use mg or g. The statement says "担 / 擔 is the only character that has a metric value measured in kg", which matches the table.

Final Answer: Yes
